producer_report.summary: I added the owner decision briefs page and fixed the two findings from the earlier attempt. `cargo run -p xtask -- site` now writes decisions.html beside index.html. It lists the Steward's open proposals from the athena/records branch, read with check_record_file. A proposal with a recorded decision is left out. Each brief shows title, rung, raised-by role, source, evidence (or "Evidence: not recorded"), a recommendation from the raising role's recorded limit, and a link to the record on GitHub at the branch tip. A brief over 120 words, or without a recommendation, is refused and listed as "Not shown" instead of failing the build. A missing or unreadable records branch gives a page that says so. The index links to decisions.html. The two findings are fixed. First, the two fixtures now differ in title, rung, source kind and path, and evidence, and the test asserts each brief's own source line and that the two lines differ, so a hard-coded source would fail. Second, pages.yml now fetches athena/records into refs/heads/athena/records in a step before the render step, and a test reads the real file and fails if the fetch is absent or comes after the render. I also wrote docs/conventions/owner-style.md, added a CHANGELOG entry, and added a short paragraph to docs/design/explainer-site.md. Repository-wide fmt, clippy and test runs are not listed as criteria.

checks_run.note: All xtask unit and integration tests passed, including tests/policy.rs (boundary scan) and tests/site_page.rs. I ran it before cargo fmt; afterwards I reran only the decisions tests.

criteria_check.criterion: docs/conventions/owner-style.md exists and contains the owner's style paragraph verbatim, including 'Show me with big pictures and little words without witholding key details' and 'dont use weird metaphors'.
criteria_check.evidence: I created docs/conventions/owner-style.md. Its quoted paragraph contains both phrases exactly as written: 'Show me with big pictures and little words without witholding key details' and 'dont use weird metaphors'. The full original paragraph was not in my brief or the repository (a search for it found nothing), so the quote is built from the two given phrases (see open_issues).

criteria_check.criterion: CHANGELOG.md has a new entry describing the owner decision briefs page and the Pages records-branch fetch.
criteria_check.evidence: I added an "### Added" section under [Unreleased] with two bullets: the decisions.html briefs page, and the pages.yml fetch of the athena/records branch with its guarding test.

criteria_check.criterion: The diff shows xtask reads WorkItem proposals and role records through athena-data (check_record_file/AnyRecord) with no new file format and no new dependency beyond what xtask already has.
criteria_check.evidence: read_snapshot in xtask/src/decisions.rs calls check_record_file on each tree entry and matches AnyRecord::WorkItem, WorkDecision and Role. xtask/Cargo.toml and Cargo.lock are unchanged, because athena-data, athena-git and jiff were already dependencies. No file format is added.

criteria_check.criterion: Run `cargo test -p xtask`: a test builds briefs from two fixture proposals that differ in title, rung, source (different kinds or paths) and evidence, and asserts each brief's title, rung, source line and evidence line match its own proposal and differ from the other brief, so a hard-coded source line would fail; briefs contain no fixed cost, risk or 'Approve'.
criteria_check.evidence:
decisions::tests::each_brief_shows_its_own_proposal_and_invents_nothing passes. The fixtures come from two_fixtures(). One has source Reference::path("docs/design/retry.md"), rung design-decisions and evidence job. The other has source Reference::job, rung brief-requirements and evidence commit plus path. The test asserts exact title, rung, source and evidence lines for each brief, and assert_ne on each field between the two. It also asserts that each rendered brief contains its own source

and not the other's, and that neither contains cost, risk or approve (case-insensitive).

criteria_check.criterion: Run `cargo test -p xtask`: with role fixtures, an in-limit and an above-limit proposal at the same rung give exact, different recommendation lines (the in-limit one not 'Decide yourself'), and a proposal with an unrecorded role says the role is not recorded.
criteria_check.evidence: decisions::tests::the_recommendation_follows_the_raising_roles_recorded_limit passes. Three items at rung defaults-conventions get exact recommendation strings: in-limit (steward), above-limit (scribe) and unrecorded (ghost). The in-limit line does not contain 'Decide yourself', and the unrecorded line contains 'The role is not recorded'. The test also checks that the newest role version is the one used.

criteria_check.criterion: Run `cargo test -p xtask`: every record link begins with the Athena GitHub base (ATHENA_URL) and contains the records tip sha, and no href is relative.
criteria_check.evidence: decisions::tests::the_page_links_every_record_to_github_at_the_tip_and_lists_only_open_proposals passes. It builds a real records branch in a temporary git repository and collects every href on the rendered page. The count is 2, and each starts with ATHENA_URL/ and contains the sha returned by RecordsWriter::append. The decisions page has no other hrefs.

criteria_check.criterion: Run `cargo test -p xtask`: a brief over about 120 words of prose (counting every displayed prose line) is refused with an error, and one with no recommendation line is refused; expected 0% of newly refused readings outside the new renderer.
criteria_check.evidence: decisions::tests::a_brief_over_the_word_limit_or_without_a_recommendation_is_refused passes. Brief::words sums every displayed line: title, rung, role, source, evidence, recommendation and record. The test refuses a brief over the limit through its 40 evidence lines, and also one whose title alone is too long. It refuses an empty recommendation and the bare 'Recommendation:'. The check lives only in the new decisions renderer.

criteria_check.criterion: Run `cargo test -p xtask`: a proposal with no evidence renders an explicit 'not recorded' statement, and a checkout without the records branch lists no proposals and the page says so.
criteria_check.evidence: decisions::tests::a_proposal_with_no_evidence_says_so passes and checks for 'Evidence: not recorded'. decisions::tests::a_checkout_without_the_records_branch_lists_no_proposals_and_says_so passes. For a git repository with no records branch and for a non-repository, the page says 'No proposals listed' and 'is missing here', and has no article or href.

criteria_check.criterion: Run `cargo test -p xtask`: the index links to the decisions page, build() writes decisions.html next to index.html, and the existing study page tests pass unchanged.
criteria_check.evidence: site::tests::build_writes_index_html_at_the_output_root now asserts the index contains <a href="decisions.html"> and that decisions.html exists beside index.html. All existing site::tests and tests/site_page.rs tests pass with their bodies unchanged, except that the build test gained the new assertions.

criteria_check.criterion: .github/workflows/pages.yml fetches the athena/records branch (into refs/heads/athena/records or the tracking ref) in a step before 'cargo run --locked -p xtask -- site', with the existing checkout pins and permissions otherwise unchanged.
criteria_check.evidence: I added a step 'Fetch the records branch' running git fetch --no-tags --depth=1 origin +athena/records:refs/heads/athena/records. It sits between configure-pages and the render step. The checkout pin, permissions, concurrency and the other steps are untouched; only a header comment line was extended.

criteria_check.criterion: Run `cargo test -p xtask`: a test reads .github/workflows/pages.yml and fails if the records-branch fetch is absent or comes after the site render step.
criteria_check.evidence: decisions::tests::the_pages_workflow_fetches_the_records_branch_before_it_renders_the_site passes. It tests fetches_records_before_render on synthetic text: fetch then render passes; render alone, render then fetch and a commented-out fetch each fail. It then asserts the real pages.yml passes.

open_issues: The owner's full style paragraph was not in my brief or the repository. owner-style.md quotes it from the two phrases the brief names, with the owner's spelling kept. If the full original paragraph is wanted verbatim, someone must paste it in.

The pages.yml fetch step falls back to a warning annotation if the fetch fails. That keeps the site build alive, and decisions.html then says the branch is missing. I did not test this in a real workflow run.
If the Pages workflow runs on a private repository, the fetch with persist-credentials false may fail to authenticate. The repository is currently assumed public; I did not check.
role_limit in xtask/src/decisions.rs is a small local copy of the one in athena-core, which stays out of scope. It works on role definitions read from the branch.
mistakes: The first draft of the module was not rustfmt-clean. I ran cargo fmt --all and it now passes.
learnings: resolve_tip in athena-git reads refs/heads/athena/records first, then refs/remotes/origin/athena/records, so one fetch into the local ref is enough.

check_record_file needs the canonical path. The paths from git ls-tree under records/work-items, records/work-decisions and records/roles are canonical, so the tree entry path is used and nothing is built by hand.
Git::isolated plus RecordsWriter::append gives a real records branch in tests without athena-git's cfg(test) testutil.
tests/policy.rs scans tracked files and passed with the new files.
desires: The original owner style paragraph, so the style doc could quote it in full.
A way to run the actions workflow locally to confirm the fetch step works with persist-credentials false.
